description: This file defines an abstract class JdbcElement used in the Apache OFBiz framework for handling JDBC datasource configuration elements. It processes XML elements to extract specific attributes such as 'isolation-level' and tracks the line number in the configuration file.

classes.name: JdbcElement
classes.description: An abstract class representing a JDBC configuration element with attributes for isolation level and line number, constructed from an XML DOM Element.

methods.name: getIsolationLevel
methods.description: Returns the isolation level attribute value for the JDBC element.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the configuration file line number associated with this element.
